`final class Tween`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseTween<Tween>`](/reference/animation/basetween/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Tween.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/Tween.java)

Moves one `float` value, read and written through a getter and a setter, to a target over a duration.

## Description

The getter is read when the tween begins, after its delay, so a tween placed in a sequence starts from the value that the previous steps left.
[`TweenAnimator.tween`](/reference/animation/tweenanimator/#TweenAnimator-method-tween) gives a tween already wired to an animator.
A duration below `0` throws an `IllegalArgumentException`.

- [Animation](/use/learn/style-and-motion/animation/)

### waypoint

`this waypoint(float waypoint)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds a value to pass through on the way, after the previous waypoints, then returns this tween.
